2607.10522.title: Towards Autonomous and Auditable Medical Imaging Model Development
2607.10522.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to automate machine learning engineering (MLE) by coupling planning, code execution, debugging, and empirical feedback. Translating this capability to medical imaging remains difficult because each task imposes modality-specific experimentation and strict requirements for validation protocols and prediction artifacts. Here we introduce AMID, an autonomous multi-agent framework for medical imaging model development. AMID first proposes Data-Conditioned Method Planning, which refines coarse task-level search spaces into executable, parallelizable method lanes grounded in task-specific data analysis and runnable medical-imaging resources. It then develops Verification-Guided Two-Stage Optimization, moving from broad early exploration of diverse method lanes to selective exploitation of promising candidates while enforcing strict verification of validation protocols, metric computation, and prediction artifacts throughout the optimization. Across 20 medical imaging challenge tasks spanning diverse modalities and prediction types, AMID outperformed evaluated general-purpose MLE systems and, on several tasks, approached or matched strong human-designed challenge solutions. These results suggest that AMID can turn task-specific medical imaging model development from bespoke manual engineering into an agentic workflow for producing high-performing and auditable model artifacts across heterogeneous tasks.
2607.10522.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理開始通過結合規劃、代碼執行、除錯和實證反饋來自動化機器學習工程（MLE）。將這一能力轉化為醫學影像仍然困難，因為每個任務都對模態特定的實驗和驗證協議及預測工件提出了嚴格的要求。在這裡，我們介紹了AMID，一個自動化的多代理框架，用於醫學影像模型開發。AMID首先提出了數據條件法規劃，將粗略的任務級搜索空間細化為可執行的、可並行的基於任務特定數據分析和可運行醫學影像資源的方法通道。然後，它發展了驗證引導的兩階段優化，從對多樣方法通道的廣泛早期探索轉向對有前景候選者的選擇性利用，同時在整個優化過程中強制執行驗證協議、指標計算和預測工件的嚴格驗證。在涵蓋多種模態和預測類型的20個醫學影像挑戰任務中，AMID的表現超過了評估的通用MLE系統，並且在幾個任務上接近或匹配了強大的人工設計挑戰解決方案。這些結果表明，AMID可以將任務特定的醫學影像模型開發從定制的手動工程轉變為一個代理工作流程，以生成高性能和可審計的模型工件，涵蓋異構任務。
